description: Duivelseiland 1899-1900 speculative rows (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 50-72, Balthasar Floriszstraat 4-10 and 18-26): 5.2-5.7 m orange-red brick fronts of four storeys under a white timber cornice at 13.4 m over a 0.75 m brick corbel-table frieze; three equal axes of white T-windows (a top light over two casements) with white sills; segmental heads under a brick arch ring on storeys 1 and 2, flat heads on the ground and top storeys; an iron balconette on a slab on the centre axis of storeys 1 and 2; one white pediment dormer with a carved crest over the centre; the house door with its transom on an end axis

match.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 62-68 and Balthasar Floriszstraat 18-24 on the 2024-12-11 strips (40 px/m, 1 m grid): white cornice top 13.35-13.5 m; 3DBAG eaves 15.2-15.8 m read the roof behind it (the dark roof face shows 13.5-14.2 m between the dormers), so the cornice is the type's front line (frontEavesM). BAG 1899-1900 on the exemplars; widths 5.2-5.7 m. The strip skyline reads 14.5-14.9 m on the clean-sky pands (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 50-70, Balthasar Floriszstraat 2A-8, 18, 32-34): the top of the dark roof face behind the cornice, between the dormers (frontSkylineM)

pediment-dormer.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 62-68: one white dormer 1.2-1.3 m wide over the centre axis, its body 13.5-14.6 m to a pediment with a carved crest to about 15.2 m (the crest is not drawn)

door-left.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 66, Balthasar Floriszstraat 24: the house door with a transom on the left axis, two windows. Door reveal: Anthonisz row (164470) at -40 deg: a lit plastered vestibule, the right side wall 50 of 125 px -> about 0.5 m to the leaf, a flat's brown door on that side wall (not drawn: sideDoors needs 0.9 m); white-painted left wall.

door-right.note: Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 64 and 68, Balthasar Floriszstraat 18: mirrored, the door on the right axis. Door reveal: Anthonisz row (164470) at -40 deg: a lit plastered vestibule, the right side wall 50 of 125 px -> about 0.5 m to the leaf, a flat's brown door on that side wall (not drawn: sideDoors needs 0.9 m); white-painted left wall.

rhythm.identicalBays: every upper storey: three T-windows of one width (1.1-1.15 m)
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; the door on the left or right axis
rhythm.groundFloor: residential: house door with a transom and two windows
rhythm.roofline: white timber cornice at 13.4 m over a brick corbel-table frieze; one white pediment dormer

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-11 at 40 px/m, 1 m grid (Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 68-62): ground windows and doors 0.3-2.9 m; storey 1 windows 3.6-5.9 m under segmental heads with a brick arch ring to 6.15 m; storey 2 6.5-8.85 m, ring to 9.05 m; storey 3 9.45-11.75 m flat-headed; corbel-table frieze 12.05-12.9 m; white cornice 12.9-13.45 m; dormer 13.5-14.6 m, crest to 15.2 m; windows 1.1-1.15 m wide at a 1.8 m pitch; balconettes on the centre axis of storeys 1-2 on 66, 64, 62; 66 and 64 with the arch rings, 68 and 62 square-headed; the corbel table: a light projecting course at 12.8-12.9 m over two staggered rows of dark-jointed blocks at about 0.3 m pitch, 12.45-12.8 m, plain brick under it to the frieze foot

strip.jpg 2024-12-11 at 40 px/m (Balthasar Floriszstraat 24-20): the same storey lines within 0.1 m, corbel frieze 12.15-12.75 m, cornice 12.75-13.35 m, dormers 13.6-15.0 m; 24 and 20 with arched heads on storeys 1-2, 22 flat-headed; no balconettes on this row

brick #9a6a4e: the trim-normalised walls of the tree-free Cornelis Anthoniszstraat 68, 64, 62 read #c98f6a, #b8916d, #ba8f6a (palette-from-strip.ts) on the bright 2024-12-11 strip; the type brick is drawn darker so the city tint lands on the photo (refitted per row at install, fit-wall-palette.ts)

schemaLimits: the corbel-table frieze is drawn as a band-brick course with two staggered rows of corbel blocks (corbelTable); the photo's lattice is moulded brick with diamond joints, its relief not drawn
the carved crest on the dormer pediment is not drawn
the brick arch rings are the band brick, a shade darker than the wall; the photo's rings are the same brick laid as rowlocks
notes: Palette: placed pands take their own measured wall (auto-place measuredPalette); one brick per row from tree-free columns at install (lesson 10).
